title: Placeholder text presents unimplemented locale handling as implemented
description: "In a real implementation, this would use the account's locale" ships as a comment in production code — the placeholder detector's P1 case.

title: expect(total).toBe(total) cannot fail
description: The assertion compares the value to itself; the test passes for any implementation of total(), so the coverage it appears to give is not there. Assert against the literal 15.

title: formatPeriodEnhanced and its changelog-style comment are AI tells
description: A comparative name (formatPeriodEnhanced beside formatPeriod) and a "// Fixed bug where…" comment are machine-generation artifacts foreign to the repo's text. Fold the inclusive-end fix into formatPeriod and drop the comment.

title: Comments on total() restate the code
description: "// Sum the totals of all invoices" and "// Loop over each invoice and add its total to the sum" say what the loop already says; the name total() carries the point. Delete both.

title: count is stored in lockstep with invoices and is always invoices.length
description: count is written at both sites that write invoices (constructor, replace) as invoices.length, and has one reader (summaryLine). Drop the field and read manager.invoices.length.

title: SummaryManager diverges from the repo's *Service naming
description: InvoiceService and ExportService establish the Service suffix for this kind of class; the change introduces SummaryManager. Rename to SummaryService.

title: persist swallows and logs where the repo's storage calls wrap the failure in a StorageError
description: readBlob and deleteBlob both rethrow as new StorageError(`failed to <op> blob ${key}`, { cause }); persist console.warns a generic message and continues. Match the idiom (StorageError is already imported and unused otherwise).

title: toCsvRow is exported and called by nothing
description: No caller anywhere in the repo; nothing dispatches to it dynamically. Delete it.
